# Introduction

## Getting Started

This presentation uses the Metropolyst theme, a highly configurable variant of the classic Metropolis style.

**Default settings:**

- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Fonts: Fira Sans throughout
- Accent color: Orange (#eb811b)
- Header background: Dark teal (#23373b)

## Bullet Points

You can use standard Markdown:

- First point
- Second point
- Third point with **bold** and *italic* text

## Two Columns

::: {layout-ncol=2}
### Left Column

Content for the left side.

### Right Column

Content for the right side.
:::

# Main Content

## Code Blocks

```python
def hello_world():

```

## Links and Emphasis

Visit the [documentation](https://github.com/benzipperer/metropolyst) for all configuration options.

Use `#alert[text]` in Typst blocks for highlighted text.

# Conclusion

## Summary

Metropolyst provides a clean, professional presentation style with easy customization through YAML front matter.

```{=typst}
#focus-slide[
  Thank you!
]
```
